recap.text: The Hoarder drops a scrap of paper called a Neighborhood Map, and Donut grabs a second one for herself. At Carl's touch, about a square mile of his minimap fills in, with hardly any red dots and the pulsing X of Rebecca W, level 3, dead less than two hundred metres from the safe room. He finds no blue dots, and outside the map's area red dots show only when he is right on top of them.

Carl falls onto the corpse of the Divider as his dynamite blows, the corpse bursts, and he lands unconscious on a roof across the street. Donut grabs the neighborhood map, leaps out of the pool, and finishes off the last three monsters with two magic missiles and Mongo. She then leaps up to the roof and uses a heal scroll on Carl.

Carl assembles the Chariot in four minutes outside the town gates, with a four-chamber missile tube newly mounted beside his swivel seat. The neighborhood map from the dead goose shows the boss about half a mile east, a cyborg death bird recharging for the night atop a sand dune. Carl calls her too close and says they need to go west, a mile and a half away.

beats.headline: A scrap of paper
beats.text: The Hoarder drops a single piece of loot, a scrap of paper called a Neighborhood Map. It doesn't disappear when Carl loots it, and Donut grabs one for herself. The moment he touches it, about a square mile of his minimap fills in: hardly any red dots now, several tutorial guilds, and at the edge of the square the large, pulsing X of a crawler's corpse, Rebecca W, level 3, killed less than two hundred metres from the safe room. All bosses drop persistent loot, Mordecai explains; a neighborhood boss drops a neighborhood map.
beats.gist: The Hoarder drops a Neighborhood Map; Carl touches it and his minimap fills in, showing Rebecca W's corpse.

beats.headline: Inside the square
beats.text: Carl looks up at his map for blue dots and finds none, and works through what it can and cannot show him. Outside the area of the neighborhood map, red dots don't appear unless he is right on top of them, though NPCs always show within a couple of hundred metres. Could other crawlers hide from him? Another thing to worry about.
beats.gist: Carl checks his map for blue dots, finds none, and worries other crawlers could hide from it.

beats.headline: Donut picks it up
beats.text: Carl falls onto the corpse of the Divider as his dynamite blows, the corpse bursts, and he lands unconscious on a roof across the street. She grabs the neighborhood map, leaps out of the pool, finishes off the last three monsters with two magic missiles and Mongo, then leaps up to the roof and uses a heal scroll on Carl.
beats.gist: Donut grabs the neighborhood map, kills three monsters, then leaps to the roof and heals unconscious Carl.

beats.headline: Where the boss sits
beats.text: Outside the town gates the Chariot goes together in four minutes, a four-chamber missile tube newly mounted beside Carl's swivel seat. Thanks to the neighborhood map they received from the dead goose, he can also see the boss's location: about half a mile east of town, settled atop a sand dune, a cyborg death bird recharging for the night. She's too close, he says: they need to go west, a mile and a half away.
beats.gist: The map shows a death bird half a mile east, so they go west.
